Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "can you make a watering rota for the greenhouse volunteers for next week, monday through sunday? use these beds and watering days: seedlings bench needs water every day, tomatoes on monday wednesday and friday, and citrus tubs on tuesday thursday and sunday. watering is in the morning. mara is unavailable tuesday and thursday, owen can only come monday wednesday or friday, and priya is available any day except saturday. put one volunteer on each watering task, and it’s okay if someone has more than one task in a day. please show it as a table with the day, bed, and assigned person, and include a notes section underneath with these remarks exactly: “The seedlings dry out fastest after a sunny day.” “Please don’t move the blue watering can from the south door.” don’t add calendar dates, since i haven’t given them. make the rota easy to scan, but don’t change the watering days or the volunteers’ availability.", "output": "Create a clear, easy-to-scan greenhouse watering rota for the volunteers for next week, Monday through Sunday. Do not add calendar dates.

Use these watering needs:
- Seedlings bench: every day
- Tomatoes: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday
- Citrus tubs: Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday

All watering is in the morning. Volunteer availability:
- Mara is unavailable Tuesday and Thursday.
- Owen can come only on Monday, Wednesday, or Friday.
- Priya is available any day except Saturday.

Assign one volunteer to each watering task. A volunteer may have more than one task in a day. Do not change the watering days or volunteer availability.

Present the rota as a table with columns for day, bed, and assigned person. Add a notes section underneath and include these remarks exactly:
“The seedlings dry out fastest after a sunny day.”
“Please don’t move the blue watering can from the south door.”"}]
